verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-connectivity platform, so payment initiation is a fair axis, but the pack documents no variable recurring payments, standing consents, or recurring debit flows. Instant Account Verification and Tokenized Account Numbers only supply account details that support ACH money movement performed elsewhere, which makes them developer building blocks rather than MX's own recurring-payment capability.

support.subject: As a developer, recurring bank payments are supported — variable recurring payments, standing consents, or documented recurring debit flows built on the connection
